title: KAIZEN SHEET
subtitle: CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
theme: Reduce die changeover time on Press P-3
problem: Die changeover on Press P-3, Line 3 takes 48 min on average, 6 times a day: 4.8 h of press time lost daily. The 2 setters per shift walk to a far crib for tools, hand-tighten 8 bolts and set the height by trial runs.

analysis.note: Minutes per changeover, average of 30 observations

rootCause.material: Tools kept in a crib 30 m away

counterMeasures: Shadow board with the full tool set at the press
Next die pre-staged on a cart while the press runs
Shut-height stopper blocks end trial runs

before.description: Tools fetched from a crib 30 m away; 8 bolts tightened by hand.

after.description: Shadow board at the press; quick clamps; die waiting on a cart.

horizontalDeployment.plan: Lines 4 and 5 (same die family) by Dec 2026; owner S. Patil.

benefits.summary: OEE 61% → 72%. Setters no longer leave the press; SOP SW-P3-012 posted and 12 operators trained.
